name: awesome-cnc
desc: A curated list of CNC machines, firmware, software, learning resources and communities for hobbyists and professional machinists.

resources.name: Bantam Tools Desktop CNC
resources.desc: Enclosed, US-made desktop mill for machining aluminum prototypes and PCBs, with its own milling software.

resources.name: Makera
resources.desc: Desktop CNC machines with probing and quick or automatic tool changing: the Carvera, Carvera Air and Z1.

resources.name: Nomad 3
resources.desc: Carbide 3D's fully enclosed desktop mill for metal, wood, wax and PCBs, with an 8x8x3 in cutting area.

resources.name: Penta Machine
resources.desc: Maker of the Pocket NC desktop 5-axis mill and the compact 5-axis Solo.

resources.name: AltMill
resources.desc: Sienci Labs linear-rail, ball-screw CNC router for production work in 2x4, 4x4 and 4x8 ft sizes.

resources.name: Avid CNC
resources.desc: Modular CNC router and plasma table kits ranging from benchtop to 5x10 ft formats.

resources.name: LongMill
resources.desc: Sienci Labs benchtop CNC router kit for hobbyists, supplied with the gSender control software.

resources.name: Onefinity CNC
resources.desc: Ball-screw hobby CNC routers; the Elite series adds closed-loop steppers and a MASSO controller.

resources.name: Shapeoko
resources.desc: Carbide 3D's line of hobby and small-shop CNC routers, including the ball-screw Shapeoko 5 Pro.

resources.name: X-Carve Pro
resources.desc: Inventables' steel-frame, ball-screw router for small shops.

resources.name: LowRider CNC
resources.desc: Mostly 3D-printed V1 Engineering router that scales from benchtop size up to full 4x8 ft sheets.

resources.name: Maslow CNC
resources.desc: Open-source large-format router; Maslow 4 moves a sled with four belts to cut full sheets.

resources.name: MPCNC Primo
resources.desc: Mostly Printed CNC from V1 Engineering, built from 3D-printed parts and steel tubing.

resources.name: PrintNC
resources.desc: Open-source steel-tube CNC router design that can cut aluminum and steel, documented in a community wiki.

resources.name: Langmuir Systems
resources.desc: Maker of the CrossFire CNC plasma tables and the MR-1 gantry mill for home and small fab shops.

resources.name: Tormach
resources.desc: Compact CNC mills, lathes and routers for small shops, run by the LinuxCNC-based PathPilot control.

resources.name: Buildbotics
resources.desc: Open-source enclosed CNC controller with built-in stepper drivers, a web interface and a G-code planner.

resources.name: Centroid Acorn
resources.desc: Ethernet DIY CNC control board paired with Centroid's CNC12 software in free and paid tiers.

resources.name: FluidNC
resources.desc: Open-source ESP32 motion control firmware, successor to Grbl_ESP32, configured by YAML with a built-in web UI.

resources.name: Grbl
resources.desc: Original open-source G-code motion control firmware for Arduino Uno-class boards; mature and feature-frozen.

resources.name: grblHAL
resources.desc: Open-source, hardware-abstracted 32-bit successor to Grbl with drivers for many MCUs and a plugin system.

resources.name: LinuxCNC
resources.desc: Open-source real-time Linux machine controller for mills, lathes, routers, plasma cutters, robot arms and more.

resources.name: Mach4
resources.desc: Commercial Windows CNC control software from Newfangled Solutions with a plugin architecture for motion devices.

resources.name: Marlin
resources.desc: Widely used open-source 3D printer firmware with optional laser and spindle control for light CNC machines.

resources.name: MASSO
resources.desc: Standalone touchscreen CNC controllers for routers, mills, lathes, plasma and lasers that need no PC.

resources.name: PlanetCNC
resources.desc: TNG control software and Mk3-series motion controllers for mills, routers, lathes and plasma.

resources.name: RepRapFirmware
resources.desc: Open-source firmware for Duet3D controller boards with a dedicated CNC mode.

resources.name: Smoothieware
resources.desc: Open-source modular G-code interpreter and CNC firmware for the open-hardware Smoothieboard controllers.

resources.name: UCCNC
resources.desc: Control software for CNCdrive's UC-series USB and Ethernet motion controllers, licensed per controller.

resources.name: bCNC
resources.desc: Open-source Python GRBL sender with autoleveling, a G-code editor and basic CAM functions.

resources.name: Candle
resources.desc: Open-source Qt-based GRBL control application with a G-code visualizer and height-map support.

resources.name: Carbide Motion
resources.desc: Free machine control software for Carbide 3D's Shapeoko and Nomad machines.

resources.name: Carvera Community Controller
resources.desc: Community-developed, open-source controller software for Makera Carvera machines.

resources.name: CNCjs
resources.desc: Open-source web interface for Grbl, Marlin, Smoothieware and TinyG controllers, often run on a Raspberry Pi.

resources.name: gSender
resources.desc: Sienci Labs' open-source sender for grbl and grblHAL machines with 3D preview and probing tools.

resources.name: ioSender
resources.desc: Open-source Windows G-code sender for Grbl and grblHAL that exposes grblHAL's extended features.

resources.name: LaserGRBL
resources.desc: Open-source Windows GRBL sender optimized for laser engraving and cutting, with image and vector import.

resources.name: Probe Basic
resources.desc: Open-source, touchscreen-oriented LinuxCNC user interface with built-in probing routines.

resources.name: Universal Gcode Sender
resources.desc: Open-source, cross-platform Java G-code sender for GRBL, Smoothieware, TinyG and g2core with a 3D visualizer.

resources.name: Autodesk Fusion
resources.desc: Commercial cloud-based CAD/CAM/CAE platform; the free personal-use license includes limited CAM.

resources.name: build123d
resources.desc: Open-source Python BREP CAD framework on OpenCascade that evolves CadQuery's ideas with context managers.

resources.name: CADProps
resources.desc: Commercial browser-based STEP viewer for checking dimensions and sections before CNC quoting; viewing requires no account.

resources.name: CadQuery
resources.desc: Open-source Python library for building parametric CAD models on the OpenCascade kernel.

resources.name: FreeCAD
resources.desc: Open-source parametric 3D modeler with sketcher, part design, assembly and an integrated CAM workbench.

resources.name: Inkscape
resources.desc: Open-source SVG vector editor often used to prepare 2D artwork for routers, lasers and plasma.

resources.name: LibreCAD
resources.desc: Open-source, cross-platform 2D CAD application that reads and writes DXF and DWG files.

resources.name: Onshape
resources.desc: Commercial browser-based parametric CAD; the free plan is for non-commercial work in public documents.

resources.name: OpenSCAD
resources.desc: Open-source, script-based solid modeler that builds 3D models from code using CSG operations.

resources.name: Pic2SVG
resources.desc: Freemium web tool that traces raster images into editable SVG paths and exports DXF for CNC artwork preparation.

resources.name: QCAD
resources.desc: Open-source, cross-platform 2D CAD; paid Professional and QCAD/CAM editions add DWG support and G-code.

resources.name: SolveSpace
resources.desc: Open-source, lightweight constraint-based 2D/3D modeler that exports DXF, STEP and STL.

resources.name: Carbide Create
resources.desc: Free design and 2.5D CAM software for routers with V-carving; the paid Pro version adds 3D tools.

resources.name: dxf2gcode
resources.desc: Open-source Python tool that converts 2D DXF, PDF and PS drawings into G-code with configurable postprocessors.

resources.name: Easel
resources.desc: Browser-based CAD/CAM and machine control from Inventables; the Pro tier is a paid upgrade.

resources.name: Estlcam
resources.desc: Commercial Windows CAM and machine control program for 2.5D, V-carving and STL machining with a one-time license.

resources.name: Fabex
resources.desc: Open-source Blender CAM extension, formerly BlenderCAM, for 3-axis and multi-axis toolpaths and simulation.

resources.name: F-Engrave
resources.desc: Open-source text and image engraving and V-carving G-code generator with inlay support.

resources.name: FreeCAD CAM Workbench
resources.desc: FreeCAD's built-in toolpath generator, named the Path workbench before FreeCAD 1.0.

resources.name: Fusion CAM
resources.desc: CAM inside Autodesk Fusion covering 2.5D to 5-axis milling, turning and editable post-processors.

resources.name: G-Code Ripper
resources.desc: Open-source G-code tool for scaling, rotary wrapping, auto-probing and splitting programs.

resources.name: Kiri:Moto
resources.desc: Open-source browser-based slicer and CAM that generates 2.5D milling, laser and 3D printing toolpaths locally.

resources.name: LightBurn
resources.desc: Commercial layout, editing and machine control software for laser cutters and engravers.

resources.name: Makera CAM
resources.desc: CAM for Makera Carvera machines, free for owners; its successor Makera Studio is in public beta.

resources.name: Mastercam
resources.desc: Commercial industrial CAD/CAM suite for mill, lathe, mill-turn, Swiss, wire EDM and router programming.

resources.name: MeshCAM
resources.desc: Commercial three-axis CAM that generates toolpaths directly from STL and DXF files with minimal setup.

resources.name: Nestbolt
resources.desc: Open-source browser nesting of SVG/DXF parts on fixed sheets for laser, CNC and plasma, with CLI and MCP server. (Source code)

resources.name: OpenCAMLib
resources.desc: Open-source C++ library with Python bindings for drop-cutter and waterline toolpath algorithms.

resources.name: SheetCAM
resources.desc: Commercial sheet-cutting CAM for plasma, waterjet, laser, oxy-fuel and routing with nesting and lead-in control.

resources.name: svg2gcode
resources.desc: Open-source Rust tool and web app that converts SVG vector graphics into G-code for plotters, lasers and CNC.

resources.name: Vectric
resources.desc: Commercial Windows router CAD/CAM: Cut2D for 2D, VCarve for 2.5D and V-carving, and Aspire for 3D reliefs.

resources.name: CAMotics
resources.desc: Open-source three-axis G-code simulator that renders toolpaths and the resulting cut workpiece in 3D.

resources.name: NC Viewer
resources.desc: Free browser-based G-code viewer and machine simulator that processes files locally.

resources.name: FSWizard
resources.desc: Free online and mobile feeds and speeds calculator from Zero-Divide, the developer of HSMAdvisor.

resources.name: G-Wizard
resources.desc: Commercial feeds and speeds calculator from CNCCookbook for mills, routers and lathes, with a hobby Lite edition.

resources.name: HSMAdvisor
resources.desc: Commercial Windows feeds and speeds calculator with a tool database and cutting force estimates.

resources.name: 3axis.co
resources.desc: Free DXF, SVG, CDR and STL files for CNC routers, laser cutters and plasma tables.

resources.name: Bantam Tools CNC Projects
resources.desc: Free desktop-milling projects in aluminum, brass and PCB stock, with G-code and Fusion files under a CC BY-NC-SA license.

resources.name: Clickspring
resources.desc: Commercial and free metric PDF drawings for the clock parts and shop-made tools built in the Clickspring machining videos.

resources.name: CutRocket
resources.desc: Carbide 3D's free project-sharing site for Carbide Create, Vectric and Fusion projects, open to any machine.

resources.name: Design & Make
resources.desc: Commercial library of CNC-ready 2D and 3D relief clipart in V3M, STL and RLF formats for Vectric software.

resources.name: Easel Project Gallery
resources.desc: Community projects made in Easel that can be opened, customized and carved on your own machine.

resources.name: FireShare
resources.desc: Langmuir Systems' library of plasma, laser and MR-1 milling projects in DXF, STEP and Fusion formats; mostly free, some paid.

resources.name: Hemingway Kits
resources.desc: Commercial model-engineering and workshop-tool projects, such as the Quorn tool and cutter grinder, sold as kits or drawings.

resources.name: Home Model Engine Machinist Plans
resources.desc: Forum board where members share model engine plans, many free, for steam, IC and Stirling engines, often with CAD files.

resources.name: Little Machine Shop Projects
resources.desc: Free beginner machining plans, such as an oscillating engine, a knurling tool and vise clamps.

resources.name: Makerables
resources.desc: Makera's project-sharing platform with free CNC project files, filterable by machine.

resources.name: Tormach Project Library
resources.desc: Free machining projects with CAD and CAM files, G-code, materials lists and step-by-step directions, made for Tormach machines.

resources.name: Vectric Free Projects
resources.desc: Over 300 free CNC and laser projects with files, materials lists and step-by-step videos.

resources.name: 3Dfindit
resources.desc: Free CADENAS search engine for manufacturer-certified CAD models with shape and sketch search; successor to PARTcommunity.

resources.name: FreeCAD Parts Library
resources.desc: Community-maintained, CC BY-licensed parametric FreeCAD parts with STEP exports, including fasteners, bearings and profiles.

resources.name: GrabCAD Library
resources.desc: Millions of free CAD models shared by engineers, with STEP and native files for fixtures and machined parts.

resources.name: MakerWorld
resources.desc: Bambu Lab's model community, with many free printable jigs, fixtures, vise jaws and shop accessories.

resources.name: McMaster-Carr
resources.desc: Industrial supply catalog whose product pages offer free 2D and 3D CAD downloads of fasteners, clamps, dowel pins and other hardware.

resources.name: MISUMI inCAD Library
resources.desc: Free downloadable CAD assemblies of 200+ machine mechanisms such as clamps, indexing tables and positioning units.

resources.name: Printables
resources.desc: Prusa's model library, including many printable CNC jigs, fixtures, dust shoes and accessories.

resources.name: Thangs
resources.desc: Geometric search engine that finds 3D models across many sharing sites.

resources.name: Thingiverse
resources.desc: Large 3D model repository that also hosts CNC router designs, jigs and machine upgrades.

resources.name: TraceParts
resources.desc: Free library of supplier catalog parts in STEP, native CAD and 2D formats, with plugins for major CAD tools.

resources.name: Carbide 3D Getting Started with CNC
resources.desc: Free introductory course on CNC terminology, tooling, software and workflow.

resources.name: CNCCookbook Free CNC Training
resources.desc: Self-paced guides on G-code, feeds and speeds, CAD/CAM and CNC fundamentals.

resources.name: Haas Learning Resources
resources.desc: Hub for Haas Tip of the Day videos and training on CNC setup and programming.

resources.name: LinuxCNC G-code Reference
resources.desc: Detailed reference for RS274/NGC G-codes as implemented in LinuxCNC.

resources.name: Machinery's Handbook
resources.desc: Standard reference for mechanical engineering and machining, now in its 32nd edition.

resources.name: RepRap G-code Wiki
resources.desc: G-code and M-code reference across RepRap-family firmwares such as Marlin and RepRapFirmware.

resources.name: Titans of CNC Academy
resources.desc: Free CAD, CAM and CNC machining courses built around projects, with downloadable prints, models and setup sheets for each part.

resources.name: Abom79
resources.desc: Job-shop machining and repair work from a third-generation machinist.

resources.name: Blondihacks
resources.desc: Hobby machine-shop projects, lathe work and beginner-friendly machining lessons.

resources.name: Carbide 3D
resources.desc: Tutorials and live shows on Shapeoko and Nomad machines, Carbide Create and Carbide Motion.

resources.name: Clough42
resources.desc: Lathe, CNC and electronics projects, including the electronic leadscrew build series.

resources.name: Cutting Edge Engineering
resources.desc: Heavy machining, line boring and repair of mining and earthmoving components.

resources.name: Haas Automation
resources.desc: Official Haas channel with Tip of the Day lessons on CNC setup and programming.

resources.name: Inheritance Machining
resources.desc: Restoring a family machine shop and documenting detailed machining projects.

resources.name: NYC CNC
resources.desc: John Saunders' channel on Fusion CAD/CAM, CNC machining and running a machine shop.

resources.name: Sienci Labs
resources.desc: LongMill and AltMill tutorials, gSender guides and hobby CNC project videos.

resources.name: Stefan Gotteswinter
resources.desc: Precision manual and CNC machining, scraping and shop-made tooling.

resources.name: This Old Tony
resources.desc: Home-shop machining projects and tool builds explained with dry humor.

resources.name: Titans of CNC
resources.desc: Titan Gilroy's channel on production CNC machining, multi-axis work and free training.

resources.name: Winston Moy
resources.desc: Desktop CNC projects, Shapeoko builds and digital fabrication experiments.

resources.name: Carbide 3D Community
resources.desc: Forum for Shapeoko and Nomad owners and Carbide Create and Carbide Motion users.

resources.name: CNCArena
resources.desc: IndustryArena's manufacturing forum and the successor to CNCzone.

resources.name: The Hobby-Machinist
resources.desc: Forum for home-shop machinists with beginner sections and machine-specific boards.

resources.name: Langmuir Systems Forum
resources.desc: Owner forum for CrossFire plasma tables and the MR-1 mill.

resources.name: LinuxCNC Forum
resources.desc: Official user forum for LinuxCNC configuration, HAL, GUIs and machine builds.

resources.name: Maslow CNC Forums
resources.desc: Community forum for Maslow builds, calibration, firmware and projects.

resources.name: Onefinity CNC Forum
resources.desc: Owner forum for Onefinity machines, upgrades and MASSO controller questions.

resources.name: Practical Machinist
resources.desc: Large forum for professional machinists covering CNC, CAM, tooling and shop management.

resources.name: r/CNC
resources.desc: Subreddit for CNC machining discussion across hobby and industrial machines.

resources.name: r/hobbycnc
resources.desc: Subreddit for hobby CNC routers, mills and lasers.

resources.name: r/Machinists
resources.desc: Subreddit for manual and CNC machinists, programmers and apprentices.

resources.name: Sienci Community Forum
resources.desc: Forum for LongMill, AltMill and gSender users.

resources.name: V1 Engineering Forum
resources.desc: Community forum for LowRider and MPCNC builds, troubleshooting and projects.

resources.name: Awesome 3D Printing
resources.desc: Printers, slicers, CAD and resources for 3D printing.

resources.name: Awesome Electronics
resources.desc: Resources for electronic engineers and hobbyists.

resources.name: Awesome Makera
resources.desc: Resources for Makera desktop CNC machines, including the Carvera, Carvera Air and Z1.
